blurb: Soul to Sole Dance Company offers dance classes and programs for children, youth, and adults in multiple styles such as ballet, jazz, tap, hip hop, lyrical, modern/contemporary, musical theatre, acro, and more. They provide recreational, sessional, adult, and competitive dance programs with opportunities for performance and competition. Classes are designed to develop technical skills, creativity, and physical fitness in a positive and nurturing environment.
extraNote: Competitive Program requires participation in all three competitions/festivals and mandatory dress rehearsal · Rehearsals usually every second or third weekend, may vary due to holidays and events
